# Example .secrets
AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=test
AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=test
AWS_REGION=us-east-1
KUBECONFIG_B64=<generated below>

# Add k3s.yaml as Base64 string to secrets
$b64 = [Convert]::ToBase64String(
    [IO.File]::ReadAllBytes(".\platform-gitops\kubeconfig\k3s.yaml")
)
Add-Content .secrets "KUBECONFIG_B64=$b64"

# CI — build and push image
act push -W .github/workflows/ci-ecr.yml --secret-file .secrets

# CD — deploy Helm + sync DAGs
act push -W .github/workflows/cd-helm.yml --secret-file .secrets

# Run on ministack_network: all services resolve by Docker DNS,
# use http://ministack:4566 instead of host.docker.internal:4566,
# and the internal kubeconfig addresses resolve correctly inside the container.
act push --network ministack_network `
         -W .github/workflows/cd-helm.yml `
         --secret-file .secrets

# List all detected workflows
act -l

# Run a specific job
act -j build-push --secret-file .secrets

# ── Additional secrets needed ────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Get rds_address: cd platform-gitops && terraform output -raw aws_rds_db_address
POSTGRES_CONNECTION_URI=postgresql://mle_migrations:test@<rds_address>:5432/fraud_detection?sslmode=disable

# ── New workflow runs ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# CI: lint + push fraud_api image
act push -W .github/workflows/ci-fraud-api.yml --secret-file .secrets

# CI: atlas lint (non-main branch — no apply)
act push -W .github/workflows/ci-atlas.yml --secret-file .secrets

# CI: atlas lint + apply (simulate main push)
act push -W .github/workflows/ci-atlas.yml --secret-file .secrets \
         -e '{"ref":"refs/heads/main"}'

# CD: helm upgrade
act push -W .github/workflows/cd-fraud-api.yml --secret-file .secrets

# CD: sync DAGs to S3
act push -W .github/workflows/cd-dags.yml --secret-file .secrets

# ── All new workflows on ministack_network ────────────────────────────────────
act push --network ministack_network -W .github/workflows/ci-fraud-api.yml --secret-file .secrets
act push --network ministack_network -W .github/workflows/ci-atlas.yml --secret-file .secrets
act push --network ministack_network -W .github/workflows/cd-fraud-api.yml --secret-file .secrets
act push --network ministack_network -W .github/workflows/cd-dags.yml --secret-file .secrets
